items.title: SELLAS shares surge after Phase 3 leukemia vaccine meets overall-survival endpoint
items.summary: SELLAS reported a statistically significant overall-survival benefit for its investigational GPS leukemia vaccine in the 126-patient Phase 3 REGAL trial. Shares rose sharply in November 17 intraday trading. Full secondary analyses, FDA requirements and funding needs remain important uncertainties.

observations.label: November 17 11:20 AM EST Reuters-reported intraday reaction
observations.value: SLS approximately $20.54, +175% versus November 16 close; not a closing price

observations.label: November 17 Phase 3 REGAL topline primary endpoint
observations.value: Median overall survival 24.0 months GPS vs 14.7 months best available treatment; hazard ratio 0.59, two-sided p=0.035; n=126 randomized

observations.label: Safety and regulatory context
observations.value: Company reports no new safety signals; detailed analyses pending; plans FDA engagement and BLA submission in first half 2027

observations.label: Next checks and invalidation
observations.value: Full trial data, FDA feedback, cash needs, dilution and commercial viability; concerning subgroup outcomes or additional regulatory requirements would weaken the thesis

items.key_finding: Pivotal survival data substantiate a clinical milestone, while the three-digit intraday repricing increases regulatory and valuation sensitivity.

items.title: Indian ministry confirms missing and injured crew after MT Tara Gas Hormuz attacks
items.summary: India's foreign ministry reported that crew members aboard the LPG tanker MT Tara Gas were injured or missing following strikes near the Strait of Hormuz. Its updated account supersedes earlier initial reports that the crew were safe. The casualty update reinforces shipping security concerns but does not establish a sustained export-volume loss.

observations.label: Incident and official status update
observations.value: Attack November 16; Indian Ministry of External Affairs statement November 17, reported by several Indian news organizations

observations.label: Crew status, Indian nationals
observations.value: 24 aboard: 21 evacuated to Khasab, Oman; two injured and hospitalized; one missing; earlier safe-crew reports superseded

observations.label: Crude market context at 13:40 GMT (8:40 AM ET) November 17
observations.value: Brent $93.71/bbl +1.4%; WTI $86.97/bbl +1.5%, both intraday, not settlements; Reuters reports export recovery

observations.label: Risks and next checks
observations.value: Rescue outcome, LPG cargo and vessel damage, insurance pricing, transit counts, UKMTO/MARAD and Brent/WTI/XLE/XOP confirmation; actual sustained flow loss remains unverified

items.key_finding: Official crew-status update establishes casualties and missing personnel, not yet measurable sustained oil or LPG export losses.

items.title: Southeast Asian data-center builders sink under new US chip and remote-compute restrictions
items.summary: New U.S. restrictions targeting advanced chip exports and remote access by Chinese AI customers drove sharp declines among Malaysian data-center infrastructure companies. Reuters reports gains in China's domestic chipmaker SMIC as investors assess substitution demand. The rules create near-term customer-utilization and compliance risks, while ultimate contract losses remain unproven.

observations.label: November 17 Asian cash-session intraday observations reported by Reuters
observations.value: MN Holdings and Critical Holdings each nearly -20%; YTL Power nearly -10%; SMIC +7%; exact quote time not specified, not closing returns

observations.label: Policy catalyst
observations.value: U.S. rule restricts advanced chip shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil and access via overseas data centers serving significant Chinese AI compute demand

observations.label: Demand and capex context
observations.value: Reuters cites Malaysia $95B data-center-related investment approvals since 2021; order cancellation or utilization loss not yet verified

observations.label: Next checks and invalidation
observations.value: Effective licensing conditions, grandfathering, Malaysian hyperscaler commitments, data-center utilization and cancellations, Chinese domestic chip capacity; exemptions or continued project orders would weaken the selloff's fundamental thesis

items.key_finding: New restrictions have caused measurable regional AI-infrastructure equity stress and a semiconductor substitution divergence.

items.title: Enterprise software leads broad US equity selloff as AI weakness spreads
items.summary: US equities weakened sharply after a relatively calmer opening, with software falling more steeply than the broad indexes. Salesforce led large-cap software declines while chips, memory and data-center-power suppliers also retreated. This is intraday market evidence of widening risk aversion, not proof of falling underlying orders.

observations.value: S&P 500 -1.6%, Nasdaq -2.0%, Dow -1.7%, IGV -4.4%; all intraday, not closes

observations.value: Only 86 of 500 S&P 500 names advancing at approximately 10:56 AM EST (Barron's)

observations.label: Fundamental context
observations.value: AI spending durability, software contract growth and high financing costs under scrutiny; no independently verified cancellation or shipment shock in this pass

observations.label: Next checks and invalidation
observations.value: NVDA after-close earnings, IGV breadth and price action, software cRPO, memory demand, data-center project commitments and Treasury yields; strong guidance and broad stabilization would weaken selloff thesis

items.key_finding: Software-led market breadth deterioration shows the AI-linked selloff spreading across multiple sectors.

items.title: Iranian drones targeting Bahrain intercepted; Gulf escalation, no confirmed US damage
items.summary: Iran launched drones toward a US radar site at Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain. Bahrain and US Central Command reported interception without damage to US equipment or injuries to American personnel. The incident heightens Gulf and Hormuz security risk, but does not confirm a new physical oil-export disruption.

observations.label: Security development, November 17
observations.value: Iranian drone attack reported; Bahrain and CENTCOM say intercepted, no US equipment damage or American injuries; Iran claims radar strike without independent confirmation

observations.label: Oil observation, November 17 08:10 AM EST report
observations.value: Brent near $92.93/bbl, down about $0.49 in the cited intraday snapshot; not settlement

observations.label: Physical flow
observations.value: No independently confirmed incremental oil export loss attributable to Bahrain strike

observations.label: Fundamentals, risks and invalidation
observations.value: Ample/recovering global supply partly offsets geopolitical premium; verified damage or sustained Hormuz transit/cargo losses would overturn muted supply-effect assessment

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: CENTCOM/Bahrain releases, UKMTO/MARAD, vessel and cargo status, Hormuz transits, war-risk insurance, Brent/WTI and XLE/XOP relative strength

items.key_finding: A corroborated military escalation raises Gulf security risk, but physical oil-supply disruption is unverified.
